baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ... تُورُونَ joins an attention-demand to the addressees' act of bringing out fire.
baseline_models.mechanism: The question directs sight and consideration toward a transition: fire is first potential within the kindling medium, then the addressees make it emerge as a burning, luminous event.

activation_trace.role: The attention-and-inquiry formula makes the ordinary act of kindling an object of deliberate examination.
Burning fire supplies the visible, moving result whose production is being examined.
Fire latent in the fire-stick and brought out by striking supplies the transition from hidden capacity to actual flame.

changed_reading.before: A question about a fire that people light.
changed_reading.after: A demand to inspect the threshold at which human action draws an actual flame out of a latent combustible capacity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ, ٱلنَّارَ, and تُورُونَ binds seeing and light to a root inventory that includes both eliciting hidden fire and concealing a thing behind another appearance.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can stage ignition as epistemic disclosure: light becomes seen when the concealed potential is brought out, while the form-distant concealment branch of و ر ي keeps open the question of whether the visible effect hides its source.

activation_trace.role: Causing something to be seen supplies the disclosure side of the mechanism.
Illumination supplies the perceptible effect that makes disclosure possible.
The literal emergence of fire from the stick anchors the model in the focus verb.
Concealment and displaying something other than the hidden object introduce the exploratory tension between visible flame and veiled source.

changed_reading.before: The fire is simply a visible object produced by kindling.
changed_reading.after: The kindled fire can be read as a disclosure event whose visible brilliance both reveals a hidden capacity and risks screening off the source behind that capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The wider sequence repeatedly separates a familiar human operation from origination, and 56:72 applies that separation directly to the fire's tree. Human kindling remains real, but it is the terminal release of a capacity carried by a substrate whose coming-to-be is assigned elsewhere.

activation_trace.role: The addressees' eliciting fire from a fire-stick defines their immediate but limited operation.
Origination and bringing into existence establish the sequence's larger category of agency.
Causing a thing to arise supplies the contrasted upstream act on both sides of the explicit agency question.
The literal tree supplies the material carrier from which the focus fire is kindled.

structural_cues: The second-person تُورُونَ in 56:71 is immediately followed by 56:72's أَأَنتُمْ ... أَمْ نَحْنُ agency contrast about the fire's tree.
Earlier seed, crop, and water units use the same human-operation versus origination pattern.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated agency contrasts, the kindling verb, and the fire's tree; I supply the dependency arrow from originated tree to latent capacity to human ignition. A live alternative is that 56:72 only corrects ownership of the tree and does not analyze stages of causation.

changed_reading.before: The addressees are presented as producers of the fire they kindle.
changed_reading.after: Their action is recast as derivative activation: they release fire from an originated material order rather than originating either its substrate or its fire-bearing capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated أَفَرَءَيْتُم prompts turn ordinary acts into a disciplined sequence of attention. The surrounding calls to remember and give thanks, followed by the designation of this fire as a reminder, convert seeing from passive perception into retrieval of dependence and an answering disposition.

activation_trace.role: The focus formula explicitly demands attention and an answer rather than mere ocular registration.
The earlier recurrence establishes the focus wording as one step in a repeated interrogative exercise.
Bringing something back after forgetfulness supplies the cognitive movement expected from repeated observation.
Recognition of benefit and its giver supplies the response toward which attention is directed.
A thing made to remind identifies the fire itself as a mnemonic instrument.

structural_cues: The identical أَفَرَءَيْتُم formula opens the seed, crop, water, and fire inspections at 56:58, 56:63, 56:68, and 56:71.
The fire question is followed two ayat later by the explicit predicate تَذْكِرَةً.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated attention prompts, remembrance language, gratitude language, and the fire-as-reminder predicate; I infer a pedagogical arrow from seeing through recollection to recognition. They could instead be adjacent but independent exhortations.

changed_reading.before: The opening formula asks the audience to notice the fire.
changed_reading.after: It recruits the audience into a repeated cognitive practice in which inspecting the kindled flame retrieves obscured dependence and calls for recognition rather than bare observation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus description places the kindled fire in a need-and-sustenance frame and activates the image of an empty, resource-poor tract. Fire therefore becomes portable infrastructure whose heat, light, and service matter most where the surrounding environment supplies little.

activation_trace.role: The burning fire supplies the concrete resource whose use is being located.
Kindling makes the resource locally available when and where it is needed.
A usable thing for needs and subsistence assigns the flame a practical provisioning role.
A barren, empty place with little good supplies the environmental condition in which that provision becomes acute.

structural_cues: 56:73 coordinates تَذْكِرَةً and مَتَاعًا as two functions of the fire just questioned, then marks its beneficiaries with لِلْمُقْوِينَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fire, practical benefit, and the barren-place branch of ق و ي; I infer a use-setting in travel or encampment and the arrow from environmental scarcity to heightened utility. The beneficiary term may instead be broader and need not denote travelers specifically.

changed_reading.before: The ayah evokes a generic or domestic act of lighting a fire.
changed_reading.after: It can evoke a deliberately kindled survival resource, especially potent in an empty tract where light, heat, and usable provision must be made locally.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus names fire rather than an explicit road marker, and the beacon and mutual-visibility branches are secondary activations. It remains anchored in the focus roots for fire and seeing and gains spatial support from the immediately following barren-place branch; downstream prose should present it as a possible camp or route signal, not as the fire's exclusive function.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلنَّارَ is something seen after the attention formula, and its root inventory includes a visible guiding marker while the seeing inventory includes groups or fires facing one another.

activation_trace.role: A conspicuous marker or beacon extends the fire's light into spatial orientation.
Mutual visibility of groups, dwellings, or fires supplies a social relation across distance.
The barren open tract supplies the setting in which a visible fire can orient or connect separated people.

changed_reading.before: The kindled fire serves those immediately gathered around it.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the flame also projects human presence across empty ground, functioning as a visible camp marker or beacon by which distant parties can orient to one another.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 56:70 applies أُجَاجًا directly to water, while the heat image comes from another branch of the same root. It remains valid as an immediate context activation anchored back to the focus fire, but downstream prose should mark it as lexical cross-domain resonance rather than claim that the water is literally aflame.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus ٱلنَّارَ and تُورُونَ immediately follow a water counterfactual whose root inventory spans bitter salinity and intense burning heat.

activation_trace.role: Bitter saline water anchors the actual counterfactual state in the preceding ayah.
Blazing and intense heat form the root-internal bridge from the threatened water state to the following fire.
The actual burning fire receives and concretizes the preceding root's heat resonance.
Eliciting latent flame keeps the cross-element activation tied to the focus event.

changed_reading.before: The passage moves cleanly from a completed water example to a separate fire example.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the threatened water already carries a heat-bearing lexical edge, so the fire question unfolds an elemental resonance latent in the immediately preceding counterfactual.

strongest_changes: Human kindling became derivative activation once the next ayah distinguished it from originating the fire's tree.
The repeated seeing formula became a mnemonic discipline aimed at recognition and response, not passive observation.
The fire acquired a concrete wilderness-provision setting through the coordinated benefit and barren-place cues of 56:73.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses visible flame, latent capacity, and human activation into one question; the context then separates immediate operation from origination and assigns the same fire mnemonic and material functions. The concealment branch of و ر ي and the water-to-heat span of ء ج ج preserve two unusually productive but contained readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The ق و ي activation may designate travelers or users in barren land specifically, or it may support a broader beneficiary class.
The concealment-disclosure and أجاج heat resonances are branch-distant and should remain exploratory rather than control the primary reading.
